title: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN COMMUNITY AND CRIMINAL JUSTICE (Brescia) Faculty of Social Science - Sociology

sections.heading: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN COMMUNITY AND CRIMINAL JUSTICE (Brescia)
Academic Requirements
lines: Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 3.0 principal courses, including 1.0 from Sociology courses at the 1000 level plus 2.0 additional courses, with no mark in these principal courses below 60%.

sections.heading: Additional Requirements
lines: To register in this module, students are required to submit a Community Development Application Form by May 1 (late applications will be considered at the discretion of the program). Enrolment in this module is limited. Meeting the minimum requirements does not guarantee that students wishing to transfer into this module will be offered enrolment. Priority will be given to students already registered at Brescia.
1.0 course: Sociology 2240E or Sociology 2270A/B and Sociology 2271A/B.
2.0 courses: Sociology 2205A/B, Sociology 2206A/B, Sociology 3306A/B, one of Sociology 3307F/G or Sociology 3322A/B.
3.5 courses: Sociology 2215A/B, Sociology 2253A/B, Sociology 2266A/B, Sociology 3330F/G, Sociology 3331F/G, Sociology 3333F/G, Sociology 3334A/B.

1.5 courses from: Sociology 2223A/B, Sociology 2256A/B, Sociology 2259, Sociology 2260A/B, Sociology 2267A/B, Sociology 3346F/G, Sociology 3360F/G, Family Studies and Human Development 3345A/B or the former Family Studies 3345A/B.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
